findings.title: Service targets a port the pods do not have
findings.cause: Service web sends traffic to the named port "web", which no selected pod declares (they have named ports http (8080)), so it has no endpoints

evidence.what: Service port 80 targets the named port "web"
evidence.command: kubectl get service web -n kd-service-port-name -o jsonpath='{.spec.ports}'

evidence.what: the selected pods declare named ports http (8080)
evidence.command: kubectl get pod web-59c4f75cc7-5hb5w -n kd-service-port-name -o jsonpath='{.spec.containers[*].ports}'

evidence.what: Service has 1 ready endpoints although 1 of its pods are ready

findings.fix: Set the Service's targetPort to a port the pods declare, or name the container port "web".
